name: SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, distributes computer components, smartphones, and office automation equipment in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Commercial Products, Consumer Products, Value Added Products, and Phones. It offers servers, home and business PCs, storage and networking devices, printers/scanners, and monitors; and private cloud, enterprise storage and backup, and security services. The company is also involved in the service and rental of computers and accessories. SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
